1939 Register, schedule 83, 7 Hamilton Drive, ED letter code RMGB, Nottingham registration district 430-3, sub-district 26, The National Archives RG101/6178A - read from the page by A. Hagues; sub number 7; the line reads Lowe with PERRY written above it in a later hand. WHICH OF THE TWO IS THE NAME ON THE NIGHT IS NOT SETTLED: this record's rule takes the name on the line as the night name and the hand above it as the amendment, which makes her Alice V Lowe, afterwards Perry - but the index writes her Lowe (Perry), and elsewhere in this record the bracketed name has been the night name. Entered as Lowe with Perry kept as a name she can be found under, and the direction left open
